verdict.rationale: Docs cover a Notion migration guide (structure via object types, Markdown+CSV export) but explicitly rely on manual curation ('curate structure before export', 'select only content you intend to migrate') rather than automated preserved import; there is no mention of Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown import, nor evidence attachments/links are automatically preserved. missing for 10: Evernote import support, Roam import support, generic Markdown import with link/attachment fidelity, automated (non-manual) structure preservation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of successful imports.
